purpose: Read-only exploratory localization of CE mean reconstruction versus saved DDPM generation; optional completed MSE reference, no model or new random draws.

arrays.train_posterior: values shape (279,2,16,48), index1 axis component0=mu,component1=log_sigma; labels 0=FREE,1=AMD
arrays.generated_posterior: values shape (16,2,16,48) per terminal; must equal generated_*.npz posterior_parameters
arrays.generated_z: saved z shape (16,16,48); no regenerated draw
arrays.sigma: exp(saved log_sigma) in float64 for descriptive arithmetic
arrays.epsilon_residual: (saved z - saved mu)/exp(saved log_sigma), deterministic inverse only; rounding means not an exact saved independent epsilon tape

frozen_analysis_items.definition: All train279 and generated32 per method; terminal train counts expected126 FREE/153 AMD, generated16 each. Peptides are primary observational units; coordinate counts 768/peptide are denominators only, not independent samples. One seed trajectory/batch per terminal is not 16 independent training runs.

For mu/log_sigma/sigma and saved z/derived epsilon: finite count, mean,std(ddof0),min,max,RMS, quantiles[0,.01,.05,.25,.5,.75,.95,.99,1]; retain per-peptide mean,std,RMS,min,max and summarize across peptides.
No train posterior sampling. Report analytic E[z]=mu, E[z²]=mu²+sigma², mixture mean/std/RMS pooled and per peptide/channel/position; no mixture quantiles or empirical train-z claim.

Pearson correlation over aligned coordinates pooled descriptively, per peptide, and of channel/position means; null if zero variance. Report centered-within-peptide version. No p-values or effective coordinate sample count.

For each field report channel16 and position48 mean/std/RMS profiles. Compare generated-vs-train mean profiles by correlation/RMSE and RMSE divided by training pooled RMS; report flattened16x48 mean-map correlation/RMSE and within-distribution adjacent position/channel coordinate correlation, descriptive only. Positional coordinates retain padding; no token-derived mask.

Generated mu/log_sigma/sigma fraction outside same-terminal training pooled min/max and pooled1%-99% interval; matched-coordinate min/max and1%-99% coverage; all coordinate fractions accompanied by16 per-peptide fractions, no selection/no inferential tests.
Compare saved generated z pooled and structured means/RMS against analytic same-terminal training qz; no claim finite or similar moments establish fit.

Read frozen code/config and existing independent audit; record common seeds and draw shapes/order. No RNG calls. Compare CE/MSE deterministically recovered epsilon residual arrays only as approximate consistency, never proof of exact stored epsilon or distributional independence. Inventory genuinely stored independent epsilon separately if available.

Read every row of existing train/dev reconstruction exports, verify row identity order, compute descriptive visible-sequence real-token accuracy, exact reconstruction and length MAE by split/terminal. Label mean(mu) reconstruction if source says so; do not invent sample reconstruction. No new decoder calls, no new generated sequence quality scores.

failure_policy: Fail on changed hashes, unexpected shapes/labels/nonfinite critical arrays or missing completed input; do not filter, impute, clip or substitute samples. Preserve explicit unavailability for missing sampled-reconstruction or exact epsilon export.
interpretation_limits: Exploratory after observed outcome; localization and hypothesis evidence only, not causal proof or fair-performance confirmation.
Training posterior rows are empirical fitted data references; generated sequences or later posterior-decoder outputs are not prospective biological evidence.
Original CE E/L/G remain not evaluable; CE recovery is phase-split with separately disclosed cost/no-retry deviation.
No model, readout, seed, budget or scalar setting may be changed from this diagnostic.
future_control_draft_only: After evidence, propose a separately scoped minimal fixed decoder control comparing independent standard-normal input versus train-posterior reparameterized input, preferring an already stored independent epsilon with explicit provenance. No control execution is authorized here.
